item.title: Skosmos vs iQvoc vs VocBench 3 in 2026: Best Self-Hosted SKOS Vocabulary Management
item.description: Every organisation of any size eventually hits the same wall: twenty people are tagging content with twenty different words for the same concept. “Customer”, “client”, “account holder” — three labels, one idea, and a search index that can never be trusted. The standard fix has existed for years and almost nobody deploys it: SKOS, the W3C’s Simple Knowledge Organization System, which turns your thesaurus, taxonomy or subject-heading list into structured, machine-readable data.
